This Week on Kickstarter

JUNE 28, 2012
This week's projects are pretty spooky! We've got a sword fighting video game, a bicoastal dance piece, and a nifty gadget to help you DIY the scariest haunted house
of them all.

;;CLANG

En garde
Legendary sci-fi author Neal Stephenson
wants to revolutionize the sword fighting game.
While buttons and triggers have always felt
inadequate for simulating real sword combat,
Clang utilizes advances in motion controllers
so you can swing, slash, and wield your sword
to victory.

Based on a yearlong correspondence between
a writer in New York and a group of dancers in
San Francisco, A Thousand Natural Shocks is
a hybrid performance of story and movement
that promises to be a "wickedly brilliant
adventure."
